        "import pandas as pd\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",

        "from vaderSentiment.vaderSentiment import SentimentIntensityAnalyzer\n",
        "import warnings\n",
        "warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')\n",
        "\n",
        "analyzer = SentimentIntensityAnalyzer()\n",
        "print(\"Libraries imported!\")"
      ],

        "colab": {

    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "def get_textblob_sentiment(text):\n",
        "    analysis = TextBlob(text)\n",
        "    polarity = analysis.sentiment.polarity\n",
        "    if polarity > 0.1:\n",
        "        return 'Positive', round(polarity, 3)\n",
        "    elif polarity < -0.1:\n",
        "        return 'Negative', round(polarity, 3)\n",
        "    else:\n",
        "        return 'Neutral', round(polarity, 3)\n",
        "\n",
        "df['TB_Sentiment'] = df['Review'].apply(\n",
        "    lambda x: get_textblob_sentiment(x)[0])\n",
        "df['TB_Score'] = df['Review'].apply(\n",
        "    lambda x: get_textblob_sentiment(x)[1])\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"✅ TextBlob Analysis Done!\")\n",
        "print(df[['Review','TB_Sentiment',\n",
        "          'TB_Score']].to_string())"
      ],
      "metadata": {

    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "def get_vader_sentiment(text):\n",
        "    scores = analyzer.polarity_scores(text)\n",
        "    compound = scores['compound']\n",
        "    if compound >= 0.05:\n",
        "        return 'Positive', round(compound, 3)\n",
        "    elif compound <= -0.05:\n",
        "        return 'Negative', round(compound, 3)\n",
        "    else:\n",
        "        return 'Neutral', round(compound, 3)\n",
        "\n",
        "df['VADER_Sentiment'] = df['Review'].apply(\n",
        "    lambda x: get_vader_sentiment(x)[0])\n",
        "df['VADER_Score'] = df['Review'].apply(\n",
        "    lambda x: get_vader_sentiment(x)[1])\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"✅ VADER Analysis Done!\")\n",
        "print(df[['Review','VADER_Sentiment',\n",
        "          'VADER_Score']].to_string())"
      ],

    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))\n",
        "fig.suptitle('🛒 Amazon Reviews Sentiment Dashboard',\n",
        "             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')\n",
        "\n",
        "colors = {'Positive':'#2ECC71',\n",
        "          'Negative':'#E74C3C',\n",
        "          'Neutral':'#F39C12'}\n",
        "\n",
        "# Chart 1 - Sentiment Count\n",
        "vader_counts = df['VADER_Sentiment'].value_counts()\n",
        "color_list = [colors[x] for x in vader_counts.index]\n",
        "axes[0,0].bar(vader_counts.index,\n",
        "              vader_counts.values,\n",
        "              color=color_list)\n",
        "axes[0,0].set_title('Overall Sentiment Count')\n",
        "axes[0,0].set_xlabel('Sentiment')\n",
        "axes[0,0].set_ylabel('Count')\n",
        "for i, v in enumerate(vader_counts.values):\n",
        "    axes[0,0].text(i, v+0.1, str(v), ha='center')\n",
        "\n",
        "# Chart 2 - Sentiment Pie Chart\n",
        "pie_colors = [colors[x] for x in vader_counts.index]\n",
        "axes[0,1].pie(vader_counts.values,\n",
        "              labels=vader_counts.index,\n",
        "              autopct='%1.1f%%',\n",
        "              colors=pie_colors)\n",
        "axes[0,1].set_title('Sentiment Distribution %')\n",
        "\n",
        "# Chart 3 - Sentiment by Product\n",
        "category_sentiment = pd.crosstab(\n",
        "    df['Product'],\n",
        "    df['VADER_Sentiment'])\n",
        "category_sentiment.plot(kind='bar',\n",
        "                        ax=axes[1,0],\n",
        "                        color=['#2ECC71',\n",
        "                               '#E74C3C',\n",
        "                               '#F39C12'])\n",
        "axes[1,0].set_title('Sentiment by Product')\n",
        "axes[1,0].set_xlabel('Product')\n",
        "axes[1,0].set_ylabel('Count')\n",
        "axes[1,0].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Chart 4 - Rating vs Sentiment Score\n",
        "axes[1,1].scatter(df['Rating'],\n",
        "                  df['VADER_Score'],\n",
